meta.name: The Last Of The Mohicans
meta.description: In war-torn colonial America, in the midst of a bloody battle between British, the French and Native American allies, the aristocratic daughter of a British Colonel and her party are captured by a group of Huron warriors. Fortunately, a group of three Mohican trappers comes to their rescue.
meta.slogan: An epic adventure and passionate romance unfold against the panorama of a frontier wilderness ravaged by war.
